title: 春日河岸钓鱼 · 第二阶段八组双模型配色对照（E0 + A）
subject: An anime illustration of one young woman with long pink hair fishing beside a river in spring. She wears an elegant ivory Western-style dress with lace and a modest full skirt, and dusty-pink platform heels with clearly visible ribbon bows. Full-body three-quarter view, both shoes visible on the dry riverbank. She holds a fishing rod naturally with both hands, the fishing line extending into the river. Fresh spring foliage, a gently flowing river and a few small blossoms already present on the bank. Her face, long pink hair, dress silhouette, bow decorations and thick platform soles must remain readable. One person, natural connected anatomy, no text or watermark.
rendering: Polished anime illustration with fine expressive contours, softly layered painted shading, readable lace and fabric folds, restrained surface detail and coherent natural daylight. Keep the same subject, action, objects, full-body framing and rendering treatment in every image.
protection_block: Preserve the intrinsic pink hair, ivory dress and dusty-pink shoes. Keep exactly one person, the existing fishing action, full-body framing, both platform heels and their ribbon bows. Do not add objects or change the time of day, pose, outfit design or drawing style.

groups.label: 春绿完整版（第一轮春绿前三条款 + K）
groups.added_block: 第一轮 spring-green-rose 条款 1~3 + K
groups.intent: 复验第一轮候选方案在两模型上的表现（v2 用 K 替换旧第四条，不与第一轮合并样本）
clauses: Organize the large background masses around muted yellow-green and deeper leafy green; use a range of light and dark values within these related hues for depth.

Let the existing pink hair, pink shoe bows and small existing blossoms carry the warm pink accents; keep these accents spatially concentrated around the young woman rather than scattered across the background.

Keep distant foliage and river reflections less saturated and less contrasty than the subject; separate the ivory dress from its surroundings with local value differences, without bleaching the whole scene.

Give the ivory dress soft cool reflected shadows from the river while retaining its ivory local color; preserve readable lace, skirt folds and shoe platform edges in the light areas.
